# klaviyo_custom_object (Resource)

A Klaviyo Custom Object schema (beta — /api/object-schemas). Defines the structure of a custom-objects type. The API does not currently expose Delete, so `terraform destroy` only removes the resource from Terraform state; the upstream schema must be removed via the Klaviyo UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    klaviyo = {
      source  = "aroma-zone/klaviyo"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "klaviyo" {
  # api_revision defaults to 2026-04-15.pre, which is required to call
  # the Custom Objects beta endpoint that backs this resource.
}

resource "klaviyo_custom_object" "person" {
  title       = "Person"
  description = "A customer-like entity from an external warehouse."
  status      = "DRAFT"
  required    = ["name"]

  properties = [
    {
      id   = 1
      name = "name"
      type = "STRING"
    },
    {
      id          = 2
      name        = "age"
      type        = "INT"
      description = "Age in years."
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `properties` (Attributes List) Property definitions. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))
- `title` (String) Title shown in the Klaviyo UI.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `required` (List of String) Names of properties that are required on records of this object schema.
- `status` (String) `DRAFT` (default) or `ACTIVE`. Note: the Klaviyo backend may report transient values (`PUBLISHING`, `UNDEFINED`) during state changes; those are surfaced read-only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Klaviyo-assigned ULID for the object schema.
- `published_at` (String) ISO-8601 timestamp when the schema was last activated. Server-assigned.
- `visibility` (String) Server-side visibility marker (`PRIVATE` or `SHARED`).

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Required:

- `id` (Number) Stable positive-integer identifier for the property within the schema.
- `name` (String) Property name.
- `type` (String) Property type. One of `BOOLEAN`, `FLOAT`, `INT`, `STRING`, `TIMESTAMP`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description for this property.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Import an existing Klaviyo Custom Object (object schema) into state.
# Replace <id> with the ULID Klaviyo assigned (e.g. "01K61DKJ7EKJ0ES9VE456XF5JG").
terraform import klaviyo_custom_object.person <id>
```
